newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end down on Wall Street wobbles.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end down on Wall Street wobbles.

text.p: Instability on Wall Street drove Portuguese shares down in nervous trade ahead of Tuesday's Fed meeting.
*PSI20 index closed down 66.31 points at 6,657.66 on volume of 4.8 billion escudos.
*PSI20 June futures were off 72 points at 6,676.

*Dealers said the fact that today was a market holiday in France and Germany had inhibited investors who would now wait to see if the Federal Reserve would raise short-term rates at its policy-making meeting tomorrow.
*"Tomorrow New York will call the tune but we won't know whether there will be a rate rise until Wednesday. I don't expect significant volume," said one trader.
*Portucel lost 27 escudos to close at 1,183 with 342,989 shares traded.
*BCP was down 36 esc at 2,949 on volume of 237,472.
*Cimpor fell 50 esc to 3,764 with 196,411 shares traded.
